# Clean app

The same shapes as the vibe fixture, with the cheap fix in place: an age gate,
a self-hosted font, no replay and no analytics tag, a marketing email footer,
renewal copy next to the subscribe button, privacy, terms, and a DMCA agent
page, a report link on uploads, alt text and landmarks, and a NOTICE for the
vendored chart. Login is not a signup. The password-reset email is transactional.

A quiet result here is still not a compliance certificate.
